top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, mature and independently replicated discovery chain: human incretin physiology (Holst), proglucagon processing and receptor biology (Drucker), and identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), with outcome-trial evidence for glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal effects. Three laureates fit the limit, and the citation is worded around physiology and the active form, so it does not adjudicate the Habener priority question or credit drug development. The attribution caveat (Mojsov versus Habener, Knudsen excluded) is real but does not outweigh the scientific merit relative to no award.
